thread:
Kayla: Quick sync — proposing a dedicated 'connector perf benchmarking lab' next Wed-Fri for Snowflake/Databricks + Qdrant/Weaviate. Goal: reproduce marketplace perf numbers, validate quantized builds, and produce a short cert report for listings. Who's in?
Mike: I'm in. Can we get DGX access for heavy runs? Also need sample datasets (5M docs, 2B tokens) — which partners can provide?
Sanjay: I can run the microbench harness and push results to /benchmarks/connector-labs. Need exact test script & warm/cold cache plan. Also add p95, median, tokens/sec, GPU mem.
Elaine: I'll coordinate partners for sample data. Proposed schedule: Wed morning infra prep, Wed afternoon smoke tests, Thu full runs, Fri analysis + draft cert. Thoughts?
Kayla: sounds good. Mike can you request DGX + QDRAM, and ask partner SIs for test creds? Also want to lock model variants: fp16, int8, awq-4. Need to run each on the same CPU/GPU profile.
Mike: Filed infra ticket #ISS-1987 and pinged hw-partners. Also added a minimal test: ```bash
./run_bench --connector snowflake --vector qdrant --model redwood-7b --quant int8 --cold-cache
```
Sanjay: added harness config to repo (branch labs/connector-perf). I'll include csv output format: header 'connector,vector,model,quant,cold,warm,p95,median,tokens_per_sec,gpu_mem_mb'
CI-Bot: Scheduled nightly smoke job for branch labs/connector-perf at 03:00 UTC starting 3035080000.
Elaine: I'll draft the cert checklist: reproducible steps, dataset checksums, perf thresholds (p95 < 200ms for 512 tokens; tokens/sec > 1000), and acceptance sign-off list (partners + eng + product). Will share by EOD.
Kayla: Perfect. Quick decision: do we include on-prem quantized builds for marketplace listing? Pros: lower cost; Cons: more variability. Vote: :+1: include, :-1: skip.
Mike: :+1: include, but tag as 'hardware-dependent' in listing.
Sanjay: :-1: skip for initial cert — let's keep listing simple. We can add follow-up 'quantized' badge.
Elaine: I'll record both in checklist and mark decision pending. Final call at 10am Wed in #partnerships.
Kayla: thanks team. I'll post the calendar invite now and attach the testing matrix.
